notes: B-102 with B-103. Printed: Basri, Devoted Paladin '[-1]: Whenever a creature attacks this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on it.'; Falconer Adept 'Whenever this creature attacks, create a 1/1 white Bird creature token with flying that's tapped and attacking.' The Adept and the Wolf are declared as attackers: one counter each (CR 508.3a, 603.2c). The Bird is put onto the battlefield attacking, so it is attacking but never 'attacked' (CR 508.4): no counter, it stays 1/1 and deals 1. Seat 1 takes 3 + 3 + 1 = 7 (20 -> 13). Before the fix only the first attacker got a counter (14); with B-103 fixed and B-102 not, the Bird's own declare row would give it a counter as well (12).
